summary: Folder navigation with breadcrumbs, file selection, and consumer-controlled previews.
whenNotToUse: To upload local files use FileUpload; for a flat list use FileManager.

props.name: items
props.description: Tree of files and folders with globally unique ids.

props.name: folderId / defaultFolderId / onFolderChange
props.description: Controlled or initial folder; null means the root.

props.name: onOpenFile / renderPreview / renderActions
props.description: Opening, preview, and actions provided by the consumer.

keyboard.action: Navigates folders, selects files, and opens previews.

accessibility: Breadcrumbs, buttons, and checkboxes have accessible names; images use alt text provided by the consumer.
responsive: Actions wrap and previews respect the available width.
customization: Use renderPreview and renderActions to integrate the formats and operations you need.
commonMistakes: Use unique ids across the whole tree; don't expect automatic file system access.
limits: No built-in file system, remote loading, moving, or persistence.
